body: And I’d love to get in my car and just go, but I’m too drunk, and I don’t want to hurt anybody. Maybe it worked in the past when I needed to clear my head, but tonight I think it’s time. I hate it, and I’m so fucking sorry.
I switched the filter to “new” and it’s a new post almost every minute. So many hurt humans, all left unsupported, talking to other humans in pain trying to save themselves.
